method: Current canonical exports imported through the n8n CLI into the shared local n8n (localhost:5678) and exported again for exact node and connection comparison, with no editor save or activation. The canvases were inspected at zoom-to-fit in a separate throwaway local n8n editor (port 5895, test owner login, deleted afterwards) because the shared editor requires the operator's own sign-in. Node and label rectangles were measured in the browser and the screenshots saved as canvas-*.png. n8n's floating Execute workflow buttons were hidden for the screenshots only.
savedPngBoundary: The canvas PNG files were captured on 28 September 2026 from the current 61-node exports. review-preview.png and handoff-preview.png show the regenerated offline demo pages.
